title: Desert: every god at war
prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: the future where all six gods grasp for supremacy and the world itself is the battlefield: a scorched desert plain split by chasms under a sky torn into six clashing colours (fire, ice, shadow, sea-green, leaf-green and gold), with colossal shapes of the gods fighting far off on the horizon.
alt: A scorched desert under a sky split into six colours, colossal gods fighting on the horizon.
